title: CE41011: Flows In Boundary Layer
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Inviscid irrotational and viscous fluid flows; fundamental equations of viscous
flow; continuity equations of viscous flow; transition to turbulence; NavierStokes equations and their solutions; Couette flows; viscous and turbulent
boundary layers; similarity solution for two-dimensional flow; boundary layer
approximation; free shear flow; flow stability; concept of small disturbance
stability.
